images.caption: Figure 1:(1) Given a natural-language policy and a small pool of seed samples, (2) the optimizer compiles the policy into (3) a decomposition program: predicates answered by weak models, deterministic extractors, and Python code that composes their outputs into a verdict. (4) Adversarial generators extend the training pool with counterexamples where the program departs from the policy, at the level of a single predicate (local) or the composition as a whole (systemic). The loop repeats, optimizing the program and its training data jointly.
